sources.topic: Pipe registration schema/capacity, status flags, snapshot/stream modes, reference counts, forced stop, typed writes and output batching

contract.context: Explicit Acquisition; five numbered pipes, 32767 records each, combined reserved byte limit
contract.records: Portable little-endian numeric leaves, finite REAL32, fixed NUL-padded ASCII strings, field/array order without alignment; exact concrete resource-free type identity
contract.registration: Uninitialized values may supply schema; unique uppercase plain PIP filenames; current executing source program default, including linked calls
contract.lifecycle: Reference-counted activation; forced/final stop flushes pending output; inactive/no-reader unregister; state retained across task completion
contract.readers: Binary read-only PIP FILEs; stream cursors release complete records after all readers advance; snapshots freeze at OPEN; bounded reader/view bytes; transactional failed READ
contract.overflow: Newest complete records retained; lagging open stream-reader flags sticky; successful writer-root overflow flags suppressed
contract.output: Synchronous append batches through explicit MemoryFiles, DeviceFiles or rooted DirectoryFiles; preflight and retain bank state on sink failure; no implicit backend or automatic retry
contract.persistence: Checked schemas/lifecycle and bounded whole-record hex; pending batches and start counts retained; live readers prevent save; no writer identity/cursor/monitor restoration

boundaries: No native record layout/status/mode enum equivalence, CMOS lifetime, robot sampling or PC monitor connections
No asynchronous flush, network transport, text/write PIP access or automatic acquisition
Snapshot refresh occurs on reopen; source FILE offsets are relative to retained data
DAQ_FLUSH is not externally observable; strict mode deferred
